name: pivot
description: Reshape a long-format DataFrame into a wide table using pandas pivot_table (or crosstab), turning a column's unique values into new column headers.
usage: ``index`` (required) sets the row keys; ``columns`` (required) is the column whose unique values become headers; ``values`` populates the cells. ``aggregate`` is the aggregation applied to duplicate entries (default ``first``). ``type`` selects ``pivot`` (pandas pivot_table) or ``crosstab``. ``fill_value`` fills missing cells; ``multilevel`` keeps multi-level headers.

attributes.name: reset_index
attributes.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the result index after pivoting.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Engine to use: ``pivot`` (pandas pivot_table, default) or ``crosstab`` (pandas crosstab).

attributes.name: multilevel
attributes.description: If ``True``, keep multi-level column headers; otherwise flatten them to ``"<value>_<column>"``.

attributes.name: pd_args
attributes.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the underlying pandas call.

attributes.name: fill_value
attributes.description: Value used for missing cells in the result (e.g. ``0``).

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Column(s) used as the pivot row index. A single column name or a list.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Column whose unique values become the new column headers.

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Column(s) whose values populate the pivot cells. Optional for ``pivot``.

attributes.name: aggregate
attributes.description: Aggregation function applied to duplicate entries (pandas ``aggfunc``), e.g. ``first``, ``sum``, ``mean``, ``count``. Default ``first``.

attributes.name: totals
attributes.description: Add a totals/margins row and column (pandas ``margins``).

json_schema.title: pivot

reset_index.description: If ``True`` (default), reset the result index after pivoting.

type.description: Engine to use: ``pivot`` (pandas pivot_table, default) or ``crosstab`` (pandas crosstab).

multilevel.description: If ``True``, keep multi-level column headers; otherwise flatten them to ``"<value>_<column>"``.

pd_args.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to the underlying pandas call.

fill_value.description: Value used for missing cells in the result.

values.description: Value column(s) to aggregate into cells.

name.description: Label for the totals row/column (pandas margins_name).

json_schema.description: Pivot a DataFrame into a wide table. ``index`` and ``columns`` are required.

columnRef.description: A single column name or a list of column names.
